AI assist

The assistant reads an enquiry and proposes what goes on the quote. It is never allowed to produce a price: it returns menu items, quantities and words, and the rate engine does every calculation. So it can put the wrong dish on a quote. It cannot put the wrong rand on one.

Where the key lives. In this browser only, under this one web address. It is never written into the page, never committed, and never sent anywhere except OpenRouter. Anyone else who opens the link enters their own, so one person's key is never spent by another. Clearing site data, or a different browser or laptop, means entering it again.

Vendor photo library

Half of a Good & Proper proposal is photographs of the food. Load a vendor's pictures once and they print on every proposal that quotes them. They are stored in this browser, shrunk to 1 000px, and never uploaded anywhere.
